title: St Peter's Ilmer Baptism Register
description: Baptisms transcribed from 'The Registers and Records of St Peter's Ilmer' (Rex A Kidd, 1982), covering 1575-1982. Extracted automatically from the digitised PDF; free-text fields preserve the original transcription including uncertain readings.

baptism_date.description: Baptism date as transcribed: day-month-year or month-day-year, with abbreviated or full month names. Day and month may be omitted, or an unknown day or month marked '?'. Undated entries use '(no date)' or 'no date' followed by a year

birth_date.description: Birth date or age as transcribed; empty when absent. Dates may use day-month or month-day order, abbreviated or full month names (including 'Mch'), ordinal days such as '22d', and an optional year. Also preserves ages such as '5 years', 'Adult', and '?' for an unknown date

child_forename.description: May be empty where illegible or not transcribed

child_surname.description: May be empty where illegible or not transcribed

father_forename.description: Father's forename; for entries recorded as illegitimate this sometimes instead names the mother (the source preserves the ambiguity, e.g. 'd of William')

father_occupation.description: Father's occupation (e.g. 'lab', 'farmer', 'carpenter'), only recorded 1813-1909 and again from 1910; empty otherwise. Where a residence precedes it in the source ('Longwick lab') only the occupation is kept here - the residence stays in notes

mother_forename.description: May be empty where not recorded, illegible, or not transcribed

notes.description: Remaining free text: residence, register annotations, or (from 1910) address and occupation
